messages.author: e7a8779ef7a944e5
messages.subject: CRAN Note: "Found no calls to: 'R_registerRoutines', 'R_useDynamicSymbols'"
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to submit a package to CRAN that uses TMB.  When running `devtools::check(.)` I get a "Note":

❯ checking compiled code ... NOTE
  File 'phylosem/libs/x64/phylosem.dll':
    Found no calls to: 'R_registerRoutines', 'R_useDynamicSymbols'

There is extensive discussion online involving rstan or Rcpp, and perhaps some evidence that other packages using TMB have found work-arounds (e.g., glmmTMB here).  

Does anyone have any minimal fix for addressing this?

Jim

messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Re: CRAN Note: "Found no calls to: 'R_registerRoutines', 'R_useDynamicSymbols'"
parts: Awesome!  I confirm that adding `#define TMB_LIB_INIT R_init_mypackage` fixed it.  Thanks for putting together a clear explanation and fix
